title: Rialto Capital Advisors v. Jenel Management Corp. ($17.7M Loop Retail Condo Foreclosure)
jurisdiction: Circuit Court of Cook County, Illinois
amount: $17.7M claimed (default interest and fees on ~$16.8M principal)
summary: Rialto Capital Advisors, as special servicer for a securitized commercial mortgage loan trust, filed suit on April 1, 2026 in the Circuit Court of Cook County to foreclose on a roughly 20,211-square-foot retail condominium occupying the first two floors of a 21-story tower at 36 South State Street. The complaint alleges landlord Jenel Management Corp. and affiliated entities defaulted on the loan's scheduled maturity, with Rialto now claiming approximately $17.7 million including default interest and liquidation fees; a Cook County hearing is set for September 28, 2026.
significance: A maturity-default foreclosure on ground-floor retail, an asset type once viewed as more resilient than office, signals that the Loop's distressed-debt cycle now extends beyond office towers. CRE lenders, special servicers, and downtown retail owners should treat a strong operating history as no guarantee against maturity-wall refinancing failure in the current rate environment.
